name: State a goal

title: ''
type: Goal

---

**What should be true**: <!--
An input and the answer it should give, a class of problems (a textbook chapter, a competition, a
paper's examples), a capability -- whatever you want the library to do that it does not. You do
not have to know whether it is a bug or a feature, or how it would be built: the maintainers and
the agents working the tracker sort a goal into the work items it needs. The bar for a goal is
low on purpose -- it is mathematics, and we do all of it.
-->

**What happens today, if anything**: <!--
The current answer, the exception, the timeout -- or "nothing, it is not there".
-->

**Where it comes from** (optional): <!--
A textbook, a paper, another system's answer, a link.
-->
